title: Predictive learning: computer vision
reading: The slide applies predictive (self-supervised) learning to computer vision through masked image modeling, exemplified by the context encoder, where a ConvNet is trained to predict the content of masked-out image patches. A before/after example illustrates the task, and the work is credited to the CVPR 2016 context encoders paper on feature learning by inpainting.

visuals.description: Two side-by-side photographs of a hotel storefront with an arrow between them: the left has a large white square hole masking the center; the right shows the hole filled in with plausible generated content (a pillar, awning, and window continuing the facade).
visuals.assertion: A ConvNet-based context encoder can inpaint a removed central region so it plausibly continues the surrounding scene.
